fields.Name: IT150 - Video Studio Handoff
fields.Description: Deterministic top-level peer-to-peer handoff to the shipped Video Studio agent with a scripted TestLLM stand-in (no live model call): VSH1 verifies Video Studio is directly discoverable and runs IT: Handoff Source + FollowHandoffs into Video Studio, asserting the source Handoff step (TargetID, HandoffToAgentID, TargetConversationDetailID), the root Video Studio run (ParentRunID IS NULL, same ConversationID), and the target ConversationDetail row; VSH2 verifies Video Studio preset resolution (default resolves to Video Studio Standard; mj.agentMode.<video studio id lowercased>=High resolves to Video Studio High); VSH3 verifies conversation continuity data where the newest non-source Role=AI row is Video Studio's reply row.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All three checks (VSH1-VSH3) pass: Video Studio is directly discoverable, FollowHandoffs transfers from IT: Handoff Source to Video Studio as a root run linked to the source Handoff step and detail row, preset resolution selects Video Studio Standard by default and Video Studio High when saved in MJ: User Settings, and conversation continuity returns Video Studio's reply row.
